parsed.rationale: Both members are unnamed `extension` declarations on (presumably) `UserDefaults` within the same package `Caching`, living in two separate files — `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift` (line 15) and `DefaultsStorage.swift` (line 47). Having two extension sites on the same type within a single package creates a name-collision signal and scatters the type's surface area across files without a clear boundary. Since both records share the same package, no cross-package API boundary prevents consolidation. The conventional Swift approach is to gather all extensions on a given type that belong to the same module into a single `+Extension` file, here `UserDefaults+WXYC.swift`, and remove the extension block from `DefaultsStorage.swift` (retaining any non-extension declarations there).
